business_summary: The Sumitomo Warehouse Co., Ltd. provides integrated logistics services in Japan and internationally. It offers logistics services, such as warehousing and merchandise processing for cargo; and transportation services, including small-lot mixed load transportation, chartered transportation, and container transportation. The company also provides document storage/trunk room services that collect and deliver documents, magnetic tapes, videotapes, fixtures, and fittings; develops internet trunk room systems for inventory management; and offers services to handle safe deposit boxes, household effects, works of art, valuables, clothing, and furs. In addition, it offers harbor transportation services comprising container terminal and conventional vessel operations; husbanding, documentation, and various other services as a shipping agent; and international logistics services, including transportation, and import and export procedure services. Further, the company provides various information systems, such as SWIFT, an integrated distribution information system; and SWAN, a logistics management system. Additionally, it develops, operates, and manages rental housing and office buildings, commercial buildings, distribution buildings, business hotels, nursing homes, and galleries; provides real estate brokerage services; operates as an indemnity insurance and air cargo agent; trucking, merchandise processing service, and import/export cargo agent; international trade fair installation and cargo handling; storage and distribution of printed matters and promotional matters and business process outsourcing services; contract development of computer software, technical staff services related to software development, contract operation, and management of computer systems; operational management of parking lots; and freight forwarding. The Sumitomo Warehouse Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 스미토모 창고 주식회사는 일본 및 국제적으로 통합 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 화물 보관 및 상품 처리와 같은 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 및 소량 혼합화물 운송, 전세 운송 및 컨테이너 운송을 포함한 운송 서비스. 이 회사는 또한 문서, 자기 테이프, 비디오 테이프, 비품 및 부속품을 수집하고 전달하는 문서 보관/트렁크룸 서비스를 제공합니다. 재고 관리를 위한 인터넷 트렁크룸 시스템을 개발합니다. 대여금고, 생활용품, 미술품, 귀중품, 의류, 모피 등을 취급하는 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 컨테이너 터미널과 기존 선박 운영으로 구성된 항만 운송 서비스도 제공합니다. 운송 대행사로서 보관, 문서화 및 기타 다양한 서비스; 운송, 수출입 절차 서비스를 포함한 국제 물류 서비스. 또한, 회사는 통합유통정보시스템인 SWIFT 등 다양한 정보시스템을 제공하고 있습니다. 물류 관리 시스템인 SWAN이 있습니다. 또한 임대 주택 및 사무실 건물을 개발, 운영 및 관리합니다.
